en: Hand-colored historic postcard showing a wide cobblestone main street lined with multi‑story European townhouses and a grand corner building on the left. People in early 20th‑century clothing, including children and men in suits, stroll or stand along the street. In the background, a solitary conical hill rises beyond the town. The caption at the top reads "Lobositz. Hauptstrasse." and a small red inscription at the bottom reads "Handkolorierte Künstlerkarte."
